title: The Orchestra
overview: Micah, a hopeful romantic searching for real connection, falls for the effortlessly charming Vaughn. Their relationship begins with intoxicating passion, but beneath the surface, subtle shifts in tone and trust reveal something darker. As obsession grows, each encounter exposes a psychological power struggle where affection turns manipulative and desire blurs into danger. Through shifting perspectives, the film unravels the fragile line between love and illusion.
